auth.description: Your Ko-fi webhook verification token. Find it in Ko-fi Dashboard > Settings > API/Webhooks > Advanced Settings > Webhook verification token.
description: Receive triggers for donations, subscriptions, commissions, and shop orders from Ko-fi.
triggers.new_commission.description: Triggers when a new commission is received on Ko-fi.
triggers.new_commission.props.instructio: To receive commission events, set up a webhook in your Ko-fi Dashboard: go to Settings > API/Webhooks, paste the URL {{webhookUrl}}, and select the "Commission" event type.
triggers.new_donation.description: Triggers when a new one-time donation is received on Ko-fi.
triggers.new_donation.props.instructions: To receive donation events, set up a webhook in your Ko-fi Dashboard: go to Settings > API/Webhooks, paste the URL {{webhookUrl}}, and select the "Donation" event type.
triggers.new_shop_order.description: Triggers when a new shop order is received on Ko-fi.
triggers.new_shop_order.props.instructio: To receive shop order events, set up a webhook in your Ko-fi Dashboard: go to Settings > API/Webhooks, paste the URL {{webhookUrl}}, and select the "Shop Order" event type.
triggers.new_subscription.description: Triggers when a new subscription is received on Ko-fi.
triggers.new_subscription.props.instruct: To receive subscription events, set up a webhook in your Ko-fi Dashboard: go to Settings > API/Webhooks, paste the URL {{webhookUrl}}, and select the "Subscription" event type.
